pdpEndpoint.title: PDP Endpoint URL
pdpEndpoint.description: Full URL of the AuthZEN Policy Decision Point access evaluation endpoint (e.g., https://pdp.example.com/access/v1/evaluation)

banner.title: AuthZEN PDP Configuration
banner.text: Configure the connection to your AuthZEN-compliant Policy Decision Point (PDP). All value fields support Gravitee Expression Language (EL). When deployed on an MCP Proxy API, the policy automatically detects the API type and auto-maps MCP request data to AuthZEN fields.

authorizationHeaderValue.title: Authorization Header
authorizationHeaderValue.description: Value for the Authorization header sent to the PDP. Supports EL (e.g., 'Bearer {#context.attributes["pdp_token"]}')

subjectType.title: Subject Type
subjectType.description: AuthZEN subject type. Supports EL. Common values: 'user', 'identity', 'service'

subjectId.title: Subject ID
subjectId.description: Unique identifier of the subject. Supports EL (e.g., '{#context.attributes["user"]}')

subjectProperties.title: Subject Properties
subjectProperties.description: Additional properties to include in the AuthZEN subject object

value.title: Value (supports EL)
value.description: Property value. Supports Gravitee Expression Language

resourceType.title: Resource Type
resourceType.description: AuthZEN resource type. Supports EL. On MCP Proxy APIs, auto-mapped to 'mcp-tool', 'mcp-resource', or 'mcp-prompt' when empty.

resourceId.title: Resource ID
resourceId.description: Unique identifier of the resource. Supports EL. On MCP Proxy APIs, auto-mapped to tool name, resource URI, or prompt name when empty.

resourceProperties.title: Resource Properties
resourceProperties.description: Additional properties to include in the AuthZEN resource object

value.title: Value (supports EL)
value.description: Property value. Supports Gravitee Expression Language

actionName.title: Action Name
actionName.description: AuthZEN action name. Supports EL. On MCP Proxy APIs, auto-mapped to the tool name for tools/call, or the MCP method for other operations when empty.

actionProperties.title: Action Properties
actionProperties.description: Additional properties to include in the AuthZEN action object

value.title: Value (supports EL)
value.description: Property value. Supports Gravitee Expression Language

contextEntries.title: Context Entries
contextEntries.description: Key-value pairs for the AuthZEN request context (environment attributes)

value.title: Value (supports EL)
value.description: Context value. Supports Gravitee Expression Language

denyOnError.title: Deny on Error (Fail Closed)
denyOnError.description: If enabled, requests are denied when the PDP is unreachable or returns an error. If disabled, requests are allowed (fail open).

denyStatusCode.title: Deny HTTP Status Code
denyStatusCode.description: HTTP status code returned when the AuthZEN PDP denies access (HTTP Proxy APIs only; MCP uses JSON-RPC errors)

denyMessage.title: Deny Message
denyMessage.description: Response message when access is denied

errorStatusCode.title: Error HTTP Status Code
errorStatusCode.description: HTTP status code returned when the PDP call fails (HTTP Proxy APIs only; MCP uses JSON-RPC errors)

errorMessage.title: Error Message
errorMessage.description: Response message when the PDP call fails

useSystemProxy.title: Use System Proxy
useSystemProxy.description: Use the gateway's configured system proxy for PDP calls

connectTimeoutMs.title: Connect Timeout (ms)
connectTimeoutMs.description: HTTP connection timeout in milliseconds for the PDP call

preserveResponseContext.title: Preserve Response Context
preserveResponseContext.description: Store the AuthZEN response context as a gateway execution attribute (authzen.response.context)
